obligation: DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting
basis: The Prime A subcontract includes the clause, and the owner receives and creates controlled technical information marked CUI, which is covered defense information (252.204-7012(a)). The clause requires NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 on every covered contractor information system (252.204-7012(b)(2)(i)), FedRAMP Moderate-equivalent cloud services (b)(2)(ii)(D), and a DoD report within 72 hours (c). No size exemption

The current subcontract was awarded before 2025-11-10 and does not include DFARS 252.204-7021. Prime A notified suppliers on 2026-06-15 that the follow-on subcontract will flow down Level 2 (Self), the minimum for a subcontractor that handles CUI (32 CFR 170.23(a)(2)). A Conditional or Final Level 2 (Self) status and an affirmation in SPRS are needed before award (32 CFR 170.16(b)). The 2026-07-13 suspension of Phase 2 still lets requiring activities require Level 2 (Self) (DoD Class Deviation 2026-O0025, Revision 3)
